title: 第1734章 被偷吃了第1733章 顺其自然即可
slug: 横推九世诸位女帝一直在等我
content_zh:
“哈哈，好好好！”
叶河爽朗一笑，心境愈发松弛，
“那忆兄特意留我二人，不知所为何事？”
“并无要事，只是许久未见，留二位叙叙旧。”
忆无情浅浅一笑，语气温和真挚，
“便是想问问你们，来到永恒古星定居的这段时日，一切可还顺遂？我永恒古星，可曾让二位失望？”
“哈哈，忆兄多虑了！”
叶河朗声大笑，眼底满是真切的欢喜与安然，
“永恒古星风气安然、天地灵气充裕，个个都是人才，待在这里跟回家了一样。”
话音微顿，他连忙纠正一句，语气愈发笃定热忱：
“不对，这里早已不是异乡，于我而言，这里已然是真正的家了。”
“哈哈，那往后便只管将这里当成自己家便可。”
忆无情朗声一笑，神色松弛随和，随即话锋微转，眉眼间多了几分审慎，缓缓道出心底真正的想问：
“其实我留你们，是想问问关于此次盛典的事。
你们各个势力，如今都是怎样的看法？”
闻言，叶河神色微敛，下意识侧首看了一眼身侧默然伫立的叶孤云，稍作迟疑，方才沉下语气如实回道：
“实不相瞒，对于这次盛典，麾下众人大多心底惴惴，皆觉暗藏凶险。”
他眸光微沉，坦言道出缘由：“毕竟忆兄你的真实身份，我们已然尽数知晓，实在太过特殊，牵扯极广。”
“这段时日，我也曾特意去往无上星域各处打探流转，外界对你的风评……并不算好，甚至可以说是颇多非议。”
“众人皆忧心，盛典开启之日，必会有蛰伏的恐怖存在借机现身，对永恒古星发难。”

“也正因这份忌惮，近期已有不少寻常族人选择外迁避险，甚至有部分中小型势力，暗自改换阵营，投靠了其他古星寻求庇护。”
“嗯……”
忆无情轻轻颔首，神色平静无波，一声轻叹裹挟着几分了然，语气淡然：
“我早已预料到这般局面，也算情理之中。”
“无妨，人各有志，心生畏惧想要离去避祸，皆是人之常情，我从不强求。”
话音落下，他脸上的随和笑意尽数收敛，神色骤然肃穆沉稳，眼底透着笃定的锋芒。
“但我早已当众许诺过诸位留守之人，无论来日风波如何、危机几许，我必会倾尽所能，保全所有人的安稳。”
“你们只管安心静待盛典，真若突发变故，我有十足把握护下永恒古星，护下你们所有人。”
“我说话，一直算数。”
“这点我自然深信不疑。”
叶河重重点头，眼底满是全然托付的信任，语气恳切：
“正因信得过忆兄，我麾下势力才未曾动摇分毫，自始至终，全力配合你的所有安排。”
content_en:
"Haha, good, good!"
Ye He smiled heartily, feeling more relaxed.
"Then Brother Yi specially left us two here, why don't you know why?"
"It's nothing important, it's just that we haven't seen each other for a long time, so I'll leave you two to catch up on old times."
Yi Wuqing smiled slightly, her tone gentle and sincere,
"I just want to ask you, has everything gone smoothly during the period when you came to settle in the Eternal Ancient Star? Have I, the Eternal Ancient Star, ever let you down?"
"Haha, Brother Yi is worrying too much!"
Ye He laughed loudly, his eyes full of true joy and peace,
"The atmosphere of Eternal Ancient Star is peaceful, the aura of heaven and earth is abundant, and everyone is a talented person. Staying here is like going home."
After a slight pause, he quickly corrected himself, his tone becoming more determined and enthusiastic:
"No, this is no longer a foreign land. For me, this is my real home."
"Haha, then just treat this place as your home from now on."
Yi Qingqing laughed loudly, with a relaxed and easy-going expression. Then he changed the topic slightly, his eyebrows became more cautious, and he slowly said what he really wanted to ask in his heart:
“Actually, I’m keeping you here because I want to ask you about this grand ceremony.
What do your various forces think now? "
Hearing this, Ye He's expression slightly condensed, and he subconsciously glanced sideways at Ye Guyun, who was standing silently beside him. He hesitated for a moment, and then replied truthfully in a calm tone:
"To be honest, most of the people under my command are worried about this grand ceremony, and they all feel that it is dangerous."
His eyes darkened slightly, and he confessed the reason: "After all, brother Yi, we already know your true identity. It is too special and involves a lot of things."
"During this period, I have also deliberately gone to various parts of the Supreme Star Territory to inquire about the situation. The outside world's evaluation of your reputation... is not very good. It can even be said that there is a lot of criticism."
"Everyone is worried that on the day the grand ceremony begins, there will be a dormant terrifying existence that will take the opportunity to appear and attack the Eternal Ancient Star."
"It is precisely because of this fear that many ordinary tribesmen have recently chosen to move out for safety. Some small and medium-sized forces have even secretly changed their camps and sought refuge in other ancient stars."
"Well..."
Yi Qingqing nodded gently, with a calm look on his face. He let out a soft sigh with a hint of understanding, and said in an indifferent tone:
"I have already anticipated this situation, and it is reasonable."
"It doesn't matter. Everyone has their own ambitions. It's human nature to be afraid and want to leave to avoid disaster. I never force it."
As soon as he finished speaking, the easy-going smile on his face disappeared, his expression suddenly became solemn and calm, and his eyes showed a determined edge.
"But I have already made a public promise to those who are left behind. No matter what the storm is in the future or how severe the crisis is, I will do my best to keep everyone safe."
"You just have to calm down and wait for the grand ceremony. If something unexpected happens, I am fully confident that I will protect the Eternal Ancient Star and all of you."
“When I speak, I always count.”
"Of course I am convinced of this."
Ye He nodded heavily, his eyes full of complete trust, and his tone was sincere:
"It is precisely because of my trust in Brother Yi that my forces have not wavered in the slightest and have fully cooperated with all your arrangements from beginning to end."
